## Purpose
Knowledge sources: any file, a URL or pasted text. Each is read (Mistral OCR for PDFs, scans and Office files), distilled into short items, embedded and checked against existing guidance; the items then wait for review.

## Responsibilities
- `SourcesPanel`:
- - `knowledgeApi.sources`;
- - `addSource` ("N item(s) distilled");
- - `redistill` ("… distilled again");
- - `removeSource` ("Source deleted with N item(s)").
